basic_info.description: Discover rarely available 2-bedroom, 1-bath home in desirable Golden Gate Heights, seamlessly blending classic charm with modern potential. Featuring a spacious lower level with room for expansion, it's the perfect starter home ready to evolve with your needs.  Step into the main level & enjoy beautifully refinished original wood floors. The cozy Family Room, offers a vintage wood-burning fireplace, flows into the dining room ideal for game nights or family dinners with friends. Remodeled kitchen boasts an elegant, walnut finished, butcher block countertop & charming breakfast nook, perfect space for morning coffee, family cook-offs, or neighborhood gatherings. Ample cabinet space makes this kitchen both functional & stylish. Bedrooms are thoughtfully spaced for privacy. One ideal as nursery / quiet office, while the sunlit primary bedroom offers room for a king bed & lounging area. The backyard offers a generous space, perfect for year-round enjoyment. Whether you're hosting a BBQ, gardening, or simply soaking in the tranquility of nature, this outdoor oasis provides endless possibilities for recreation and relaxation. Garage gives access to backyard, & can accommodate 2 tandem cars & workshop. Newer 2021: Roof, windows, electrical upgrade, & refinished wood floors.
